verdict.rationale: Highnote's own issuing docs say it supports creating and managing customizable cards, including physical cards, so the core capability exists. The evidence is a single overview line, and the issuance guide covers only virtual cards. missing for 10: an API for ordering physical cards, custom card art workflow, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, evidence that Highnote manages the card manufacturer relationship, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself

citations.quote: Create and manage customizable payment cards, including virtual, physical, and tokenized digital cards.
